intake.domain: 面向二维及以上相变材料/器件的抗高频 PINN，目标动力学闭合电势/电流—焦耳热/温度—相态演化因果链
intake.venue: 中科院二区定位的方法论文候选
intake.time: 约一个月形成论文初稿；本轮仅授权文献与 idea 筛选，不授权训练
data: 可信多物理数值求解器生成的二维及以上 PCM 器件电势、温度、相态时空场与相应 PDE/本构量
以完整器件、几何、材料参数组合、脉冲协议或整条轨迹为实体分组，并设置 formal OOD
合成数值证据与实验验证严格区分，不把前者表述为后者
intake.compute: 未来 MVE 按 1 张 80GB 级 GPU、最多 10 GPU-days、无付费 API 估计；任何执行仍需后续明确批准
intake.expertise: PINN、相变材料/器件与电热相态多物理数值建模
intake.baseline: 标准 MLP-PINN、Fourier-feature/自适应谱 PINN、causal PINN/NeuSA 等强学习基线，并以二维及以上 FEM/相场多物理求解器作为数值参考
intake.user_direction: 面向相变材料/器件的抗高频PINN
intake.limitation: 现有 PINN 尚未证明能在相变切换内生地产生高频分量、移动界面和跨场刚性时，同时保持频率解析、场间一致与时间因果正确

bottleneck_statement: 对于脉冲驱动的二维及以上相变材料/器件，关键高频分量并非只存在于初态，而会随温度依赖电导、热失控和相态前沿在切换过程中内生地产生并跨电势、温度与相态场迁移；同一训练过程因而同时承受慢背景与快速局部前沿之间的频谱、梯度尺度和时间因果失配，低聚合残差仍可能对应错误的前沿拓扑、事件顺序或稳态坍缩。NeuSA 在矩形域中以谱分解和 NODE 改善波动方程的高频与因果性，但其保证依赖带限初态与 Lipschitz 向量场，未覆盖相变中后生的非平滑耦合前沿 [arxiv:2509.04966v2]；自适应谱 PINN 表明刚性会改变初值门控诱导的梯度尺度乃至方法排序，却仅在单个非线性 ODE 上验证 [arxiv:2605.04502v1]；相场 PINN 则通过退化为静态平衡明确绕开动态传播失败 [openalex:W4403555504]，而 VO2 器件观测显示实际目标包含亚纳秒电—热—相态/结构耦合及周期倍增域演化 [semanticscholar:a1448fd2600739b73894f3b8d467bf9a9e9630b2]。因此，现有方法尚不能在这一问题类上产生同时频率解析、跨场一致且因果正确的动态解。

closest_adjacent.summary_and_residue: NeuSA 把向量值初边值 PDE 投影到截断的全局谱基，并用 NODE 因果推进谱系数，同时以明确 PDE 残差训练。其保证要求带限初态和全局 Lipschitz 神经向量场，且实现针对矩形域与齐次标准边界；它没有证明能恢复由非平滑、强耦合电—热—相态转变在 t>0 后持续生成的高频内容。
该文用固定/自适应 Fourier 谱干和不同初值门控，揭示门控对残差 Jacobian 的时间缩放以及随刚性变化的方法排序反转。验证只覆盖单个弹簧摆 ODE、预设频带和门控，未包含空间界面、多场 PDE 残差或相变器件协议 OOD。
en-PF PINN 在静态相场、力学与 Maxwell 残差中加入能量耗散约束，以排除平凡平衡解。该文明确把难以直接求解的动态高阶耦合系统改写为静态问题，因此没有闭合切换轨迹中的因果传播、事件顺序或移动高频前沿。
该文通过 operando 电脉冲泵浦超快 TEM 与相场模拟，解析了 VO2 中 Poole–Frenkel 导电、电热机械耦合和周期倍增域演化，并预测亚 100 ps 切换。它不是 PINN 方法且证据集中在特定悬空 VO2 几何，因此定义了真实动态难度，却没有给出可跨器件和协议验证的抗高频 PINN 闭环。

what_phase_0_did_not_address: No retrieved frontier leaf establishes whether a 2D-or-higher PCM PINN can keep the electric, Joule-heating, thermal, and phase-kinetic residuals simultaneously accurate when a pulse creates moving fronts and new high-frequency modes after the initial condition — stakes: device researchers can accept the wrong switching time, programming energy, or phase topology despite a small aggregate loss, wasting compute and misdirecting device design.

No retrieved frontier leaf establishes that event order, front topology, and energy balance remain correct for held-out entire device geometries, material combinations, and pulse protocols that shift the spectrum and stiffness beyond training — stakes: reported gains may not transfer across devices or operating regimes, making the scientific conclusion non-general and the model unsafe as a design surrogate.

No retrieved frontier leaf tests whether one globally aggregated space-time objective over all coupled fields and switching regimes is necessary rather than assumed — stakes: if this shared assumption hides a fast local residual beneath slow-field averages, published accuracy conclusions can rest on the wrong certificate and principled high-frequency PINN design remains blocked.

method_lineage.line: PDE-/constitutive-residual PINNs for causal, high-frequency, stiff multiphysics phase-transition dynamics

nodes.method: Lagaris-style neural trial functions for differential equations
nodes.move: Represent the solution with a neural trial function that satisfies constraints and minimize differential-equation residuals.
nodes.residual_problem: The formulation did not yet provide the modern automatic-differentiation, data-plus-physics framework needed for large coupled spatiotemporal PDEs.

nodes.move: Unify PDE, constitutive, initial/boundary, and optional data mismatches in a trainable composite physics-informed objective.
nodes.residual_problem: Global residual minimization remains vulnerable to spectral bias, gradient imbalance, stiffness, and non-causal convergence in time-dependent PDEs.

nodes.move: Expose higher input frequencies to the network instead of relying on a plain smooth MLP to discover them late in training.
nodes.residual_problem: High-frequency representability still depends on frequency choices and does not by itself resolve temporal causality or stiff cross-residual conditioning.

nodes.method: Causal PINNs with time-ordered residual weighting or temporal decomposition
nodes.move: Prevent later-time residuals from dominating before earlier-time dynamics have been learned.
nodes.residual_problem: Time ordering alone does not guarantee recovery of dynamically generated high frequencies or balance multiple discontinuous coupled fields.

nodes.move: Project a PDE onto a global spectral basis, evolve coefficients through a NODE flow, and train with the reconstructed PDE residual.
nodes.residual_problem: Band-limited initial data, smooth/Lipschitz dynamics, rectangular homogeneous-boundary bases, and canonical wave tests leave endogenous discontinuous coupled phase fronts and entity-level OOD unresolved.

nodes.method: Adaptive spectral PINNs with initial-condition gates
nodes.move: Make spectral frequencies trainable and diagnose how hard initial-condition gates rescale residual gradients over time.
nodes.residual_problem: Evidence is limited to a 0D spring-pendulum ODE with selected gates and bands, leaving spatial interfaces, coupled PDE residuals, and PCM protocol OOD unresolved.

nodes.move: Add a free-energy dissipation term to coupled static PDE residuals after reformulating dynamic phase evolution as equilibrium prediction.
nodes.residual_problem: The dynamic problem is explicitly not solved straightforwardly, so transient event order, propagation, and dynamically generated high frequencies remain open.

nodes.method: LSTM-PINN for strongly coupled electrothermal transport
nodes.move: Use depth-recursive memory to maintain spatial feature dependencies and cross-field consistency in a five-field electrothermal formulation.
nodes.residual_problem: The formulation is steady-state heat/fluid/electric transport and does not include temporal phase kinetics, switching fronts, or PCM device OOD.

nodes.move: Use residual feature propagation and channel attention to improve steep-gradient and interface fidelity across coupled steady fields.
nodes.residual_problem: Validation remains on steady electrothermal benchmark regimes without phase evolution, causal pulse switching, or whole-device OOD.

nodes.method: Extended PINN for unknown switched-topology durations
nodes.move: Jointly infer piecewise topology durations, transition states, and physical parameters with a pseudolabel network and piecewise PINN.
nodes.residual_problem: Evidence is confined to parameter identification in a DCM buck converter, not a spatially distributed electro-thermal-phase PDE with moving fronts.

nodes.move: Split a difficult domain into subdomains with separate networks and interface coupling.
nodes.residual_problem: Interface coordination and where to decompose remain nontrivial for moving, field-coupled phase fronts.

nodes.move: Replace purely pointwise strong residuals with weak/variational test-function residuals.
nodes.residual_problem: Test-space and quadrature choices do not automatically resolve causal high-frequency evolution or cross-field stiffness.

nodes.method: Self-adaptive PINNs with learned residual weights
nodes.move: Adapt pointwise or termwise weights so hard residual regions receive more optimization pressure.
nodes.residual_problem: Weight adaptation can chase current errors without guaranteeing event causality, spectral transfer, or coupled conservation.

nodes.method: Discrete-time PINNs with implicit Runge–Kutta stages
nodes.move: Embed a time-stepping scheme and learn stage-consistent states instead of fitting the whole continuous time domain at once.
nodes.residual_problem: Large stage systems and unresolved spatial/coupled stiffness remain difficult when switching creates sharp fronts.

method_lineage.notes: Provenance discipline: retrieved nodes are the recent grounded frontier; parametric nodes are awareness-only and must not be cited as hard prior art. Anti-fabrication: the lineage is intentionally limited to concrete methods known well enough to name, and no missing age-band node is invented. Anti-over-conservatism: regression is flagged only against a named method and move. Collateral nodes are never gap sites or shared ancestors. Recognition inventory for this residual comprised six mechanism families—spectral/coordinate representation, causal time ordering, space-time decomposition, weak residuals, adaptive residual weighting/sampling, and solver-embedded time stepping—and the oldest confidently known representatives outside the retrieval window are included above.

domain_pattern_distribution.notes: structural_prior_encoding is the most-used observed pattern; the closest papers using it either solve canonical high-frequency PDEs or static/steady multiphysics, so dynamically generated coupled phase fronts remain the common stopping point.
